t: This entry is the Kingdom of Great Britain, a state rather than a single building. It existed from 1707 to the end of 1800, when the Acts of Union joined England and Scotland under one parliament at Westminster. Their legal systems and national churches stayed separate. Several people are linked to that era. Robert Clive, who laid the foundations of East India Company rule in Bengal, was born in this period. James Hutton, often called the father of modern geology, lived in it. Margaret Corbin, who fought in the American Revolutionary War, was born in it too.
